# oedon.dev

> Structured data, maintained and delivered.

## Capabilities

- scrape: web scraping and data extraction
  - scrape/SKILL.md
- ingest: data ingestion, deduplication, and content-addressed identity
  - ingest/SKILL.md
- dataset: automated dataset building and validation
  - dataset/SKILL.md

## API

Base: https://oedon.dev/api
Protocol: x402
Settlement: USDC
Auth: payment-native (no API keys)
